cases.name: date-range-day
cases.description: A range with no times is drawn by day
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="date" range="2026-01-01..2026-01-31" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-range-second
cases.description: precision=second draws a second inside the range, not a day
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="date" range="2026-01-01T00:00:00..2026-01-01T23:59:59" format="ISO_TIME" precision="second"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-today
cases.description: today is the run clock, floored to the day
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="date" value="today" format="ISO"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-birth
cases.description: person.b_day draws a millisecond, not a day
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="template" value="person.b_day" oldest="70" youngest="14" format="LL" local="en"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>
